name: Billy Paddock
role: Bad Lands rancher who sold his ranch to Lamb & Holland
bio: In March 1885 Billy Paddock sold his ranch down the Little Missouri to Lamb & Holland of Boston, who planned to stock it with cattle. In November 1885 he went down the river on a hunting trip.
